entries.subject: DAMIT 4273: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-4273.txt. Model 4273, version 2019-05-07, pole (328°, 28°), period 20.6338 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: NEOWISE Gr12b: selected thermal size
entries.finding: The original IRSA query was rerun for asteroid 1873; its Gr12b row matches the retained diameter 50.7990 km, error 1.1810 km, fit code DVBI and mean epoch 2455306.8986610. D in FIT_CODE means diameter was fitted. This effective-sphere diameter provides an approximate display scale, not a resolved surface or an independent physical-volume fit to the shape.

entries.subject: Source mesh and calibration preservation
entries.finding: The [original mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/13333/shape.txt) is retained without changing its coordinates or connectivity. [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) supplies the coordinate units, pole and sidereal-period conventions; its CC BY 4.0 terms and other credits are linked from NOTICE.md.

entries.subject: Hanuš 2023: updated Agenor solution
entries.finding: The paper’s new-solution table gives Agenor poles (348°, 36°) and (152°, 8°), period 20.6334 h, alongside the older (328°, 28°), 20.6338 h solution. The live DAMIT target listing and export still expose only selected older model 4273. The revised spin numbers alone cannot transform that old mesh into the new reconstruction.
entries.revisitWhen: The corresponding numerical shape is obtained from the authors’ public release or another attributable archive, with its matching spin and frame.
